title: Content-addressed generations must still be reverified
summary: deploy_tree.sh stages immutable-looking release generations keyed by a SHA-256 tree digest and flips a current symlink. A generation marker is only a hint: existing generation contents are rehashed and drift/corruption is repaired rather than trusting the marker.
invariants: Content identity is determined by file content, not release name alone.
Existing generation contents must be reverified before reuse.
Current should move atomically or as nearly atomically as the provider supports.
Mutable runtime/work output must stay outside the content digest when it is explicitly excluded from desired package content.
A damaged release generation is repaired; the marker does not overrule observed bytes.

provenance.claim: Implements tree hashing, generation directories, rehash-before-reuse, repair and current symlink switch.
Qualification explicitly states content-addressed reconciliation repairs drift.
